subject: exp-info-b
title: (R)EXP.INFO.B. -----LANG.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 276 (CMOA(II)-34). EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the partner. From LANG-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information), SG (source initiation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and STY (style), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MT-INFO: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From STY: POST (postulation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From AFTD: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and SOC (social).
